conditions.B0: L2 fixed H128 reused subject to parity and provenance gates

training_initialization: Hadamard initialization; Cayley correction exactly identity; no L4/L5 warm start
quantization: INT8 symmetric R128 over the Value axis with canonical BF16 boundary, amax/127 scale, ties-to-even round, [-127,127] clip, dequant, and immediate recurrent writeback

training_rollout.selection_rule: largest candidate with no OOM, finite nonzero gradient, and at most 900 seconds for the worst-case L7 probe
training_rollout.detach_semantics: state = state.detach(); numerical tensor retained; teacher state is never substituted
training_rollout.rotation_update_timing: one optimizer update only after the entire 512-token rollout, so the learned coordinate system is fixed within a trajectory

objectives.L6: mean over token and 18 layers of mean over batch/head [sum_K,V((student_post_qdq_native - teacher_post_update)^2) / max(sum_K,V(teacher_post_update^2),1e-12)]
objectives.L7_primary: mean over token and 18 layers of local attention out_proj relative MSE against the FP teacher output

data.source: same frozen WikiText-2 raw calibration corpus as old L4/L5
data.trajectory_start: earliest old L4/L5 sampled position that leaves 512 tokens, with deterministic right-aligned fallback

optimization.rationale_for_100_steps: confirmed historical trainer default and resource-feasible recurrent setting; each step exposes 512 recurrent tokens versus one old single-step token

multiple_testing: Holm correction across the two primary comparisons
